pages.title: Seismograph
pages.text: A heavy pendulum that the ground moves under. It times two kinds of wave from below - fast pressure waves and slow shear waves - and the gap between them says how deep their source lies.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Makes $(item)Seismic Recorder Drums$(). It must stand on a full solid block, or it hears only a fifth as fast. Each finished run reports, to everyone within 16 blocks, how deep the nearest ore or cave beneath it lies.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Geoid Model, Seismic Recorder Drum.
A paper drum turned by clockwork under a hanging pen. The ground shakes, the pen does not, and the difference is written down.$(br2)Made in $(item)Seismograph$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Seismic Recorder Drum$(): Core Drill, Geoid Model, Posterior Tablet
